nodes.text:
Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a respiratory virus that primarily affects the lungs and airways, causing respiratory illnesses in people of all ages. It was first discovered in 2001 and is similar to other viruses like respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and the flu.
